title.en: Record a handover: all accepted, partly accepted, or all rejected

goal.en: HAND names the offer, the kilograms accepted, optionally REJ with the kilograms rejected and a reason code, and a temperature. Zero accepted with REJ means the whole load was turned away.

note.en: All 36 kg accepted at 4.6 °C; no rejected line is written.
30 kg accepted, 6 kg rejected for damaged packaging.
Nothing accepted: 18 kg of hot food measured at 52 °C is rejected for temperature.
REJ without a quantity and reason: usage error.
No quantity at all: usage error.

cli: cookwala sms "HAND A7K 0 REJ 18 TEMP T52"

outcome.en: You can record the three outcomes of a handover. Next: scenarios 063 and 064 list every rejection reason code.
